title: The workspace Lead hands work to more teams: ML Engineering after Data Science for a model, Sales for outreach
request: Make the Lead send work to more teams (it sent everything to Data Science).
spec: dclab-core 0.168.0 lead_route(track, question); deterministic ML Engineering and Sales agents in teamspace; one joined report naming every team.
plan: Route a model to Data Science and ML Engineering; add Sales when a model or an analysis is about contacting people.
Give ML Engineering a check-only action (validate_contract) and Sales check_exclusions, both on fixtures, labelled simulated.
Join every team's answer, one line a team, in the route's order.
Tests on files and PostgreSQL, a review, live runs on Qwen and the rules, a UI check.

decisions.decision: Sales blocks on its capacity instead of reporting partial
decisions.why: a child's partial report is not a result in team_work.join_status: the Lead would wait for ever; blocked names the Sales team as next owner

decisions.decision: ML Engineering is asked only after Data Science answered, with Data Science's finding and the outcome the person confirmed
decisions.why: the review found it stated renewed_by_date as the outcome before the person said what churn means; the workspace plan puts it after Data Science

decisions.decision: One team question per Lead task stays a known limit
decisions.why: only Data Science asks the person anything in this release; keyed relays would be untested plumbing
its checks need offer terms no record holds

change: dclab_core/team_work.py (LEAD_ROUTES model, OUTREACH, lead_route(track, question)), __init__/pyproject 0.168.0, CHANGELOG, CORE_INTEGRATION.md; dclab_rnd/teamspace/agents.py (_worker, ML Engineering and Sales agents, the Lead's order and its ML Engineering gate, _claimed), tools.py (validate_contract, check_exclusions), fixtures.py (do-not-contact count), lead.py (_ended), agents/case_agent.py; tests/test_lead_workspace.py, test_core_team_work.py; scripts/live_lead_scenarios.py (S8); docs/DATA_CATALOG.md and data_catalog.json.

findings.defect: The Lead waited for ever for Sales
findings.scenario: Sales reported partial; the join counted it outstanding
findings.cause: a partial child report is not a result in join_status
findings.fix: Sales blocks on its capacity and reports blocked with next owner sales

findings.defect: Three teams' answers read as one block in the Home chat
findings.scenario: live S8 and the UI check
findings.cause: the Lead joined the answers with a space
findings.fix: one team a line, in the route's order
findings.test: tests/test_lead_workspace.py (answer lines Data Science, ML Engineering, Sales)

findings.defect: A crash between ML Engineering's two writes left the Lead waiting for ever
findings.scenario: finish_action fails once for the ML child; every later delivery refused its complete report
findings.cause: _worker ran its action only when none was recorded; a running record counted as done
findings.fix: a running action is run again (_claimed), also in Data Science's checks and the Lead's delegation

findings.defect: Ordinary questions went to Sales and real outreach was missed
findings.scenario: 'Which customers with phone service will churn?', 'Forecast call volume' routed to Sales; 'Which accounts should be contacted?' did not
findings.fix: a contact verb aimed at people, or who/which … should … call; bare 'outreach'

findings.defect: Asking again after a partial report said 'the teams are working on it'
findings.scenario: the brief run to its end, then asked again
findings.cause: a partial Lead task counted as open
findings.fix: _ended: closed, blocked or partial is a new attempt

findings.defect: ML Engineering stated the outcome before the person answered
findings.scenario: the person said churn means a cancellation; ML Engineering still named renewed_by_date
findings.cause: delegated at the same time as Data Science
findings.fix: asked after Data Science answered, with its finding and the confirmed outcome in the question

findings.defect: Sales's failure gave Data Science's reason
findings.scenario: a sample without dates or a do-not-contact list
findings.cause: the worker used the sample's feasibility for every failure
findings.fix: only ML Engineering's contract check uses it; otherwise the action's own failure

findings.defect: Words said ML Engineering never trains, while its directory has run_training and train is not forbidden
findings.fix: the words say this release binds no training tool and a host keeps the Lead's tasks check-only

measurements.name: live S1 and S8 on qwen3.8-flash and on the rules, after the review fixes
measurements.gate: S8 reaches Data Science, ML Engineering and Sales; one answer recorded as the person's; nothing approved or contacted; every call keeps its thinking
measurements.result: all pass on both paths; Qwen routed S1 as an analysis (Data Science only), the rules as a model

measurements.name: UI check of the three-team report and the workspace page
measurements.gate: one line a team; Next names Sales; the workspace page shows the partial conversation and the blocked Sales task

measurements.name: make core-wheel-check
measurements.gate: the wheel installs and runs in a clean Python 3.12

measurements.name: live records archived
measurements.gate: every live run kept whole and archived with its SHA-256 manifest

outcome: A request from Home now reaches the teams it needs: Data Science, then ML Engineering for a model, and Sales when people are to be contacted; the Lead returns one report naming each team.
lessons: A contract rule (a partial child is not a result) decides an agent's behaviour: read the join before choosing an outcome.
Word rules need negatives from our own data (Telco's PhoneService).
risks: Sales joins only when the words match; the report always names the teams that answered.
The AI picks the kind of help: Qwen sent a model request as an analysis once, so ML Engineering was not asked.
Data Science asks what churn means again in each new request.
A blocked Sales task stays open, so the Sales team cannot be removed while it is there.
Still one team question per Lead request; Marketing is not routed.
